title: What is crash detection?
body:
What is crash detection?

Crash detection is when your phone notices a sharp impact while moving.

How it works:
• Device sensors detect a strong collision
• ALADDIN shows a warning
• You decide whether to call for help

⚠️ False alarms are possible — always check the situation!

✅ ALADDIN helps you reach loved ones faster, but is not a substitute for calling emergency services.
